Contract RepairService::approve(sid: Integer,rid: Integer,reject: Boolean,suggestion: String): ApprovalHistory {
	definition:
		repair: Repair = Repair.allInstance()->any(r|r.Id = rid),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = sid),
		canAdvanceTo1: Boolean = (repair.Process = 0 and
		staff.Role = 1 and
		reject = false),
		canAdvanceTo2: Boolean = (repair.Process = 1 and
		staff.Role = 2 and
		reject = false),
		canAdvanceTo3: Boolean = (repair.Process = 2 and
		staff.Role = 3 and
		reject = false),
		isRejected: Boolean = (reject = true)
	precondition:
		repair.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		staff.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let ah: ApprovalHistory in
		ah.oclIsNew() and
		ah.StaffId = staff.Id and
		ah.Reject = reject and
		ah.Suggestion = suggestion and
		repair.History->includes(ah) and
		if isRejected 
		then repair.Process = 5 
		else if canAdvanceTo3 
		then repair.Process = 3 
		else if canAdvanceTo2 
		then repair.Process = 2 
		else if canAdvanceTo1 
		then repair.Process = 1 
		else repair.Process = repair.Process 
		endif  
		endif  
		endif  
		endif  and
		result = ah
}
